$comment: GENERATED by build/app-tooling.sh from the Sedna.UI stylesheet of the same version - do not edit. Extend it from the app's own Stylelint config; see https://www.sedna-ui.com/tooling

selector-disallowed-list.message: Selector "%s" names a class Sedna.UI owns. Set the component's token, use a variant the library ships, or put a class with this app's own prefix on the element.

color-no-hex.message: "%s" is a colour literal. Use a Sedna.UI token (var(--…)); a colour value belongs only in brand.css, as the value of a token the library declares.

color-named.message: A named colour is a colour literal. Use a Sedna.UI token (var(--…)); a colour value belongs only in brand.css, as the value of a token the library declares.

function-disallowed-list.message: "%s" is a colour literal. Use a Sedna.UI token (var(--…)); a colour value belongs only in brand.css, as the value of a token the library declares.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: "%s: %s" is a colour outside a token. In brand.css a colour is the value of a token Sedna.UI declares, and every other declaration reads one.

custom-property-pattern.message: "%s" is no token Sedna.UI declares, and brand.css may only redefine one. Put a value of this app's own in another stylesheet, under this app's prefix (--<app>-…).
